subject.title: feat(zalouser): add groupLink action to fetch a group's invite link

question: Should granting the existing `zalouser` tool also authorize an agent to retrieve and relay private-group invite links, or must invite-link access be separately opt-in?
rationale: The dependency call is read-only and the live behavior is proven, but the returned URL is a join capability for a private group and OpenClaw's current tool policy cannot restrict individual actions inside the `zalouser` tool.

options.title: Separate opt-in boundary
options.body: Register invite-link retrieval as a separately grantable optional tool or equivalent explicit capability so operators can allow messaging without allowing private-group invite disclosure.

options.title: Accept broad tool authority
options.body: Keep `groupLink` inside `zalouser`, but explicitly document that granting this tool includes reading and relaying private-group invite links.

options.title: Decline the capability
options.body: Do not expose group invite links to agents and close the PR if the additional disclosure authority is outside the intended plugin scope.

recommendation.title: Separate opt-in boundary
recommendation.body: Register invite-link retrieval as a separately grantable optional tool or equivalent explicit capability so operators can allow messaging without allowing private-group invite disclosure.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Zalouser group-policy work makes this person the strongest evidence-backed candidate to route the tool-authority decision.
